meta.name: make-plan
meta.description: Create a detailed, phased implementation plan with documentation discovery. Use when asked to plan a feature, task, or multi-step implementation — especially before executing with do.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将需求拆解为分阶段实施计划
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在动手前制定详细的分步实施方案。
copy.tagline_en: Break down requirements into phased implementation plans
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need a detailed phased plan before executing a feature or task.

howto.what: 装上后Claude会把任务拆成多阶段实施计划:先派子代理查文档、确认真实存在的API,再按阶段写好每一步做什么、引用哪些文档、怎么验证、别犯什么错。
howto.when: 当你要求规划一个功能、任务或多步骤实施时触发,尤其是准备用do执行前。

say.text: 帮我把Todo加搜索功能做成一份分阶段实施计划
say.note: 先做文档调研再出计划

say.text: 这个新功能先别动手写,给我列个分阶段执行计划
say.note: Claude会先找文档证据再规划

say.text: 请按make-plan的流程给这个模块写份实施计划
say.note: 会派子代理查文档并产出计划

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude breaks the task into a phased implementation plan: it dispatches subagents to check docs and confirm which APIs actually exist, then writes each phase with concrete steps, doc references, verification steps, and anti-pattern guards.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to plan a feature, task, or multi-step implementation, especially before executing with do.

say_en.text: Create a phased implementation plan for adding search to Todo.
say_en.note: Starts with doc discovery, then produces the plan.

say_en.text: Don't write code yet; give me a phased execution plan.
say_en.note: Claude gathers evidence from docs first.

say_en.text: Use the make-plan flow to write an implementation plan for this module.
say_en.note: Subagents research docs, then the plan is authored.
